SELECT ID, CREATOR, CREATE_TIME, MODIFIER, MODIFY_TIME, LOGIC_DEL, REC_VER, BUILD_IN, TENANT_ID, BUDGET_DESC, OUTLAY, DURATION_FROM, DURATION_TO, BUDGET_TYPE, USER_ID, STRATEGY_ID, REMARK FROM account_budget AB WHERE 1=1 AND AB.LOGIC_DEL = 0
AND AB.USER_ID = #{accountBudgetDto.userId}

SELECT IF(ACUA.AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND ACUA.AMOUNT > 0, ACUA.AMOUNT, AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 00:00:00') AS DURATION_FROM, CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 23:59:59') AS DURATION_TO FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user_alloc ACUA ON ACUA.COST_ID = AC.ID
WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES' AND AC.USER_ID = #{findBudgetCapacityDto.userId} AND DATE(AC.PAYMENT_TIME) = CURDATE() GROUP BY AC.ID
UNION ALL
SELECT IF(ACUA.AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND ACUA.AMOUNT > 0, ACUA.AMOUNT, AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 00:00:00') AS DURATION_FROM, CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 23:59:59') AS DURATION_TO FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user_alloc ACUA ON ACUA.COST_ID = AC.ID
WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES' AND ACUA.USER_ID = #{findBudgetCapacityDto.userId} AND AC.USER_ID <> #{findBudgetCapacityDto.userId} AND DATE(AC.PAYMENT_TIME) = CURDATE() GROUP BY AC.ID

SELECT IF(ACUA.AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND ACUA.AMOUNT > 0, ACUA.AMOUNT, AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AS DURATION_FROM, DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS DURATION_TO FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user_alloc ACUA ON AC.ID = ACUA.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES' AND AC.USER_ID = #{findBudgetCapacityDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY AC.ID
